title: Data Structures and Algorithms
subject: Computer Science
description_short: This course covers arrays, lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, binary trees, heaps, graph search, sorting, recursion and dynamic programming with rigorous worked examples and analysis. It is for university students building a foundation in data structures and algorithms.
outcomes: analyse the time and space complexity of core data structures and algorithms
implement arrays, stacks, queues, hash tables, heaps, binary search trees and graph traversals
choose appropriate data structures and algorithms for a given problem
derive recurrences and apply dynamic programming to optimisation and counting problems
recognise common implementation mistakes and correct them
